Please note: this product is Shed and Fence Stain, not paint.

Fortress 9Ltr Charcoal Shed & Fence Stain is a high-performance, water-based wood treatment formulated to protect and enhance outdoor timber structures. This quick-drying stain offers robust defence against moisture and the elements, becoming showerproof in just one hour. It is specifically developed for garden sheds, wooden fences, and other rough sawn wood, delivering a rich charcoal finish. Trade professionals will appreciate its low odour and easy-clean characteristics, ensuring efficient application and a more pleasant working environment. With coverage of up to 9m²/Ltr to provide lasting aesthetic improvement and protection for exterior wood.
